narrative: 画面消失了。在短短几帧里，只剩下曝光失控：一只灯泡、一次枪口、一张拍立得，或一次创伤。
随后下一个画面，或同一个房间，重新安定下来。这次闪白既是一处伤口，也是一次剪接点。
当剪辑应当带来痛感时使用它：记忆刺痛、爆炸、人群中的相机闪光、一个头脑的跳跃。这片白色本身就是剪辑动作。
对于一个停留在画面中的太阳鬼影，或者仅仅是两个暗调画面硬接在一起的硬切来说，这就用错了工具。如果光晕一直悬在那里、跟随一盏灯移动，那是镜头光晕。
如果你只是毫无过曝地直接跳转场景，那是硬切。
how: 把一个实景光源、频闪灯或枪口过曝到死白，或者在剪接点动画出一帧纯白画面。恢复过程可以带一点残留的雾感。
在实拍中，一位摄影师的闪光灯，或一扇通向日光的门，都可以现场完成这个效果。提示词：frame going to white then returning, bulb or explosion or memory sting, not a persistent source-linked flare。
when: 一次强烈的闪白把一张脸曝到过度，随后画面安定进入下一段记忆，就像一次刺痛式的剪接。不要在白光消失之后，还在镜头上留一道装饰性的条纹。
vs: 硬切（Smash Cut）是一次突兀的剪辑，不一定需要闪白；闪白转场则是能够承载这种剪辑的那片白色。
镜头光晕（Lens Flare）是只要光源还在镜头里就会持续存在的散射；淡入淡出（Fade In / Fade Out）是缓慢地过渡到黑或白，作为一个章节标记。
闪白是快速的。圈入圈出（Iris）收拢的是一个圆形。
它不会让整个画面全部过曝。
examples_film: 《记忆碎片》（Memento）用白色闪光作为拍立得与当下现实之间的记忆倾泻；《拯救大兵瑞恩》（Saving Private Ryan）让枪口火光和过曝以战斗刺痛的方式抹白画面。
《愤怒的公牛》（Raging Bull）中拳台上的相机闪光，是同一种过曝效果的静态摄影版本。
mistakes: 错误的近亲：持续存在的镜头光晕，或者没有曝光事件的硬切。破绽：一道从未让画面变白的彩虹条纹，或者一次画面细节完整的生硬剪辑。
解决办法：让画面在几帧内过曝至白色（或接近白色），随后恢复；如果是转场，就把接点藏在峰值里。

faq.q: 电影中的闪白转场是什么？
faq.a: 画面短暂地过曝为白色，随后恢复，用作情绪刺痛或作为一次剪接。这是把过曝当作一个事件，而不是一种持续存在的伪像。

faq.q: 闪白转场 vs 镜头光晕
faq.a: 光晕是只要光源还在场就可能持续存在的镜内散射；闪白转场则是画面在时间上的一次涂白，常常用来掩盖一次剪辑。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用闪白转场？
faq.a: 当一次剪辑或一次冲击应当是一处光的创伤时使用它：记忆、爆炸、相机闪光。不要把它当作装饰用在一个平静的主镜头上。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写闪白转场的提示词？
faq.a: 对于视频，描述画面过曝为白色再逐渐恢复的过程，并说明起因（灯泡、枪口、记忆）。对于静态画面，展示峰值或恢复阶段，而不是一道悬停不动的条纹。

narrative: The picture goes. For a few frames there is only density failure: a bulb, a muzzle, a Polaroid, a trauma.
Then the next image, or the same room, settles back. The flash is both a wound and a splice.
Use it when the cut should hurt: memory stings, explosions, still cameras in a crowd, a mind skipping. The white is the edit.
It is the wrong tool for a sun ghost that stays in shot, or for a smash cut that is only a hard join of two dark images. If the flare hangs and tracks a lamp, that is flare.
If you simply jump scenes with no blowout, that is a smash cut.
how: Overexpose a practical, a strobe, or a muzzle until clipping, or animate a white frame at the cut. Recovery can carry a lingering veil.
In camera, a still photographer's flash or a door onto daylight can do it live. Prompt: frame going to white then returning, bulb or explosion or memory sting, not a persistent source-linked flare.
when: A hard flash blows out a face, then settles into the next memory, as in a sting cut. Do not leave a decorative streak parked on the lens after the white is gone.
vs: Smash Cut is an abrupt edit without a required white-out. A light flash is the white that can carry that cut.
Lens Flare is scatter that remains while a source is in the optic. Fade In / Fade Out goes slowly to black or white as a chapter mark.
A flash is fast. Iris closes a circle.
It does not blow the whole field.
examples_film: Memento uses white flashes as memory dumps between Polaroids and the present. Saving Private Ryan lets muzzle flashes and overload wipe the frame as combat sting.
Raging Bull 's camera flashes in the ring are the still-photographer version of the same blowout.
mistakes: Wrong cousin: persistent lens flare or a smash cut with no exposure event. Tell: a rainbow streak that never whites the frame, or a hard cut in full detail.
Fix: clip to white (or near-white) for frames, then recover. Hide the splice in the peak if it is a transition.

faq.q: What is a light flash in film?
faq.a: A brief blowout of the image to white, then a return, used as a sting or as a cut. It is overexposure as an event, not a standing artifact.
Flare is stray light in the optic that can last as long as the source is in play. A light flash is a temporal wipe of the frame, often covering an edit.

faq.q: When should I use a light flash?
faq.a: When a cut or a shock should be a wound of light: memory, explosion, still-camera flash. Do not use it as decoration on a quiet master.

faq.q: How do I prompt a light flash for AI image or video?
faq.a: For video, describe a blowout to white and a settle-back, and name the cause (bulb, muzzle, memory). For stills, show the peak or the recovery, not a parked streak.
